[[File:JediHunter-FDCR.png|thumb|right|250px|A Zabrak Jedi Hunter]]
'''Jedi Hunters''' were a specialized group of [[Jedi Seeker/Legends|Jedi Seekers]] who operated far from the civilized reaches of the [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]], where dangerous predators threatened [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] life—ranging from wild beasts devouring anything in their path to twisted individuals who relished a bloodthirsty existence. In these untamed fringes, these uniquely gifted [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force adepts]] tracked, confronted, and eliminated such malice. They moved unseen through treacherous terrains, maintained constant vigilance, and struck down their targets from afar with ranged weaponry.<ref name="FDCR">[[Star Wars: Force and Destiny Core Rulebook|''Star Wars: Force and Destiny'' Core Rulebook]]</ref>

Driven neither by glory nor a desire for slaughter, they relied on their deep connection to [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to distinguish animals hunting out of survival from creatures acting out of pure cruelty. Though reluctant to disrupt the natural order, a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] Hunter stepped in without hesitation whenever a predator destroyed habitats or [[Death/Legends|killed]] needlessly. Yet, the deadliest trials arose when these dark, animalistic instincts manifested in sentient beings, forcing the Hunter to pursue intelligent quarry in the most perilous game of all.<ref name="FDCR" />
